title: Correct Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must identify that a rainbow is produced by refraction of sunlight by water droplets in the atmosphere.

title: Understanding of Refraction
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the process of refraction and how it contributes to the formation of a rainbow.

title: Clarity of Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide a clear and coherent explanation of why option (a) is correct compared to the other options.

title: Identification of Reflection
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention that reflection of sunlight by clouds does not produce a rainbow, enhancing their understanding.

title: Common Misconceptions
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid stating that a rainbow is produced by reflection of sunlight by clouds or in the human eye.
